posts.t:
That’s all folks!
Devils win 3-1 
They’ve won three games in a row & are 7-4
The vibes are god in Jersey

Arseny Gritsyuk with the empty-net goal to put this one to bed
3-1 Devils
It's Gritsyuk's fifth goal in as many games
Devils with the PK to keep the 2-1 lead
With 7:01 left in the third, the Kings head to the power play with Timo Meier to the box
The goal is Pesce's first of the season. Assisted by Luke Evangelista (4th) & Arseny Gritsyuk (3rd)

Goal!
Brett Pesce dangles at the point and fires it past Anton Forsberg
2-1 Devils

That's a wrap on the second period:
1-1 
Shots are 20-7 Devils
A goal by Scott Laughton & the response by Anthony Mantha
The goal is Mantha's 3rd of the season. Assisted by Evan Rodrigues (3rd) & Jesper Boqvist (2nd)

Goal!
Anthony Mantha goes bardown to tie it
1-1
With 6:35 left in the second, the Devils head to the power play with Scott Laughton to the box
A few good chances for the Devils but can't solve Anton Frosberg, who is up to 15 saves on the game.

That's a wrap on the first period:
Still scoreless
Shots are 5-4 Devils
Slow start to this Saturday afternoon game
With 4:02 left in the first period, the Devils head to the power play with Samuel Helenius to the box
A strong PK early on for the Devils
With 16:51 left in the first, the Kings head to the power play with Brett Pesce to the box

We are underway!
Devils-Kings
Allen-Forsberg
Should be fun!!

G: Jake Allen
#NJDevils

- Devils have Brenden Dillon in & Declan Chisholm out on the defense
- Jesper Boqvist moves to the Evan Rodrigues line with Mercer traded
- Amadeus Lombardi is in on the Glass-Brown line
#NJDevils 
- Kings are without Quinton Byfield & Cody Ceci
